description: This PHP source file defines a class 'PackageManagerRequirementsHooks' that implements Drupal hooks for checking requirements related to the Package Manager module, including version reporting, configuration validation, and failure detection.

classes.name: PackageManagerRequirementsHooks
classes.description: A class implementing Drupal hooks to check requirements for the Package Manager module, including version info, configuration validation, and failure detection.

methods.name: runtime
methods.description: Implements hook_runtime_requirements() to check and report package manager requirements, including Composer version and configuration issues.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Implements hook_update_requirements() to check requirements during update process.

methods.name: checkSettings
methods.description: Checks if the package manager has explicit settings for installation, adds an error requirement if not.

methods.name: checkFailure
methods.description: Checks for a failure marker indicating a failed package manager update and adds an error requirement if found.
